stem:
You will meet millions and travel south
In an orange blanket that smothers the sky

Which sentence from "Red Crab Invasion" illustrates a similar idea?

options.label: A
options.text: After mating, the males return to higher ground, but the females wait by the shore to lay their eggs.

options.label: B
options.text: During that journey they risk getting run over by cars, suffering dehydration, or being attacked by other animals.

options.label: C
options.text: At the beginning of this migration, it appears as though the mountain is erupting with crabs.

options.label: D
options.text: Among this great diversity are more than 100 kinds of crabs.

visual_elements:
You will meet millions and travel south
In an orange blanket that smothers the sky
